title: fix(spec,client)!: `GetTranslationsRequest` is locale-only — drop the `namespace`/`keys` filters no server reads (#3676)
body:
Closes #3676. Takes the issue's **option 1** (trim both), for reasons the issue could not have known when it was filed — see below.

## The gap, re-verified

Every claim in #3676 checks out:

| Claim | Verified at |
| :--- | :--- |
| Schema declares two optional filters | `protocol.zod.ts:957-961` |
| Endpoint description promises `namespace` | `plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:1185` |
| SDK sends both on the query string | `client/src/index.ts:3516-3519` |
| Dispatcher reads only locale | `runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts:56-73` |
| service-i18n reads only `params.locale` | `i18n-service-plugin.ts:~205-213` |
| No caller passes either field | swept `packages` / `apps` / `examples` + `objectui`: zero |

`rest-server.ts:1602` is *not* a third serving surface — it builds the metadata translation bundle on a different path. The issue's "two surfaces" framing is accurate.

## Why trim, not implement

The issue left option 2 open, blocked on "what a namespace prefix means against the flat `o.`". **That blocker expired one day later.** #3778 (filed 7-28, closed by 4cca74c) retired the flat `o.` dialect and settled the tree on one nested `TranslationData` shape. So:

- **`namespace` got *easier*.** It now lands exactly on `TranslationData`'s top-level groups — literally what its own description already said ("e.g., objects, apps, messages"). Implementation would be a one-line pick.
- **`keys` got *harder*.** Under the flat dialect, `keys: ['o.account.label']` was an obvious selection. Under the nested shape a flat `string[]` is neither a path set nor a group set, and a filtered response must be rebuilt as a sparse nested tree to stay schema-valid. That is an unmade design decision with nothing waiting on it.

Two further counts against implementing:

- **`keys` cannot deliver what it advertises.** `II18nService.getTranslations` (`contracts/i18n-service.ts:33`) takes only `locale`. A filter could therefore only post-filter an already-materialized bundle — saving wire bytes but none of the server work the name implies. Widening that contract breaks every implementer (`memory-i18n`, `file-i18n-adapter`) for a capability with no caller.
- **The docs were already right.** `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:333` and `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:495` both describe `getTranslations(locale)` as a full-bundle snapshot. The schema was the outlier.

`namespace` is trimmed alongside `keys` deliberately: re-adding an optional request field is additive and non-breaking the day the Studio's per-module views need it, whereas shipping an unexercised filter path now means dead code with tests to match. Per #3778's own reasoning — a declared-but-unread field is exactly the exemplar the next author copies.

## Changes

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` — `GetTranslationsRequestSchema` is `{ locale }`, with the rationale recorded where the next author will look.
- `packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts` — endpoint description no longer promises a namespace.
- `packages/client/src/index.ts` — `getTranslations(locale)`; the query-param construction is gone.
- `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` — regenerated (`gen:schema && gen:docs`); the diff is exactly the two rows.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` + `@objectstack/client` minor, marked breaking.

### On the tests

The client had a test asserting the query string was **built** (`client.test.ts:659`). It pinned the phantom rather than any behaviour — it asserted what was *sent*, which no server read. It is replaced by its inverse: a regression test that the request carries no filter query at all.

The spec test needed the same treatment for a subtler reason: `safeParse({ locale, namespace })` still **succeeds** after the trim, because `z.object` strips unknown keys. A success-only assertion would have stayed green whether or not the fields were removed, so the test now asserts the **parsed output** equals `{ locale }`.

## Verification

- `@objectstack/spec` — 259 files / 6745 tests pass
- `@objectstack/client` — 13 files / 173 tests pass
- `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-i18n` — pass (46 files / 665 tests)
- `check:api-surface` — unchanged (the type still exists, only its fields shrank)
- `check:docs` — 250 generated files in sync
- `client-react`, `cli` (the downstream consumers of the trimmed signature) — build clean

## Filed separately

While verifying, I found an adjacent live defect and did not widen scope into it (Prime Directive #10): `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts:94` still scans the retired flat `o.<object>.fields.` prefix in its `getFieldLabels` fallback — the exact dead dialect 4cca74c removed from service-i18n, which that commit did not reach. That fallback therefore always returns `{}`. Arguably higher severity than this issue: #3676 returned a correct superset, that one returns silently-empty output. Filed as #3833.
